verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a normalized product API that takes any product URL and returns structured pricing, variants, images and merchant offers in one response, using a consistent schema across retailers. Search responses include buy URLs, with optional user attribution appended. Hands-on community reports of missing prices or a '0' price on some listings point to data-completeness problems rather than an absent capability. Missing for 10: explicit availability/stock field documentation, a published schema or OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent confirmation of complete, accurate price data across listings.
